name: Patel Integrated Logistics Limited
about: Patel Integrated Logistics Limited provides logistics services in India. The company operates through Co-loading of Air Freight and Other Services segments. The company engages in the co-loading of air freight; and logistics and supply chain management services, including air cargo consolidation, warehousing, surface transportation, and associated value-added services. It is also involved in providing gym subscriptions, and sale of health supplements. The company was founded in 1959 and is based in Mumbai, India.
